title: Employee (target schema v1)
description: Milestone-1 target contract. The mapping engine reads field names, descriptions, types and constraints from this file. It is deliberately separate from application code and is NOT a source-header dictionary: it never lists which source columns map where.

employee_id.description: Client employee identifier. Non-empty string; preserve leading zeros; eventual canonical identity key.

full_name.description: Employee display / full name. Preserve the name as a whole; do not guess first/last-name boundaries.

work_email.description: Work email address; eventual uniqueness check. Do not invent missing addresses.

department.description: Optional. Null or one of the allowed departments. Casing/whitespace differences are cleanup (a later milestone), not a mapping blocker.

hire_date.description: Date employment with the company began; eventual normalized form YYYY-MM-DD.

contract_start_date.description: Optional. Date a contract began; distinct from employment hire date; nullable.

date-role-group.rule: A source column whose proposed target is in this group must NOT be auto-accepted on date-like values alone. Auto-accept only when the source header clearly disambiguates which role it is (via that target's disambiguation keywords) and the other group member is not a competing candidate. Otherwise escalate to human review.

identity-safeguards: Preserve employee_id leading zeros; never coerce identifiers to numbers.
Never split full_name into first/last automatically.
Never invent a missing required value.
Never auto-interpret an ambiguous date value or ambiguous date role.
